exposure: Participation in a blended Health Systems Strengthening (HSS) program
outcome: Graduates' self-reported confidence in applying HSS actions
Senior Managers' perceptions of graduates' application of HSS actions
Contextual factors influencing the application of HSS actions
cohort: 83 graduates of a Health Systems Strengthening (HSS) program designed for UNICEF staff
finding: The HSS program was well-received and led to increased confidence and changes in work practices among graduates, but contextual factors within UNICEF influenced the extent to which graduates could apply their learnings.
